purpose: Teach: カタチ/戯言/叫ば/覆う/迫り/やっかい/滑稽/有り難う

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、家族のカタチって本当に大切ね
lines.en: Sho, family really is precious, isn't it?
lines.style: Soft, warm opening. Gentle certainty — not questioning, affirming. Slow enough to let the words land. Shoulders relaxed, gaze steady on him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お友達の戯言を相手にしないことにしたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I decided not to listen to what my friend was saying anymore.
lines.style: Small, steady voice. Matter-of-fact — not defensive, just stating a choice he's made. Eyes clear. No apology in it, just fact.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが翔くんの名前を叫ばれて呼ばれたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad called out your name so loudly.
lines.style: Gentle observation, like she's noticing something tender about him. Slight smile in the voice. Wistful — remembering the moment. No rush to the end.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんを毛布で覆うのお手伝いしたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I helped Dad with the blanket.
lines.style: Quiet pride in small action. Quick, earnest — like he's reporting something he's pleased about but not boasting. Slight lift at the end, seeking her approval.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、テストが迫り来るから準備しようね
lines.en: Sho, your test is coming up soon. Let's get ready together.
lines.style: Practical but warm. Not commanding — inviting. 「準備しようね」carries gentle partnership, not pressure. Steady, encouraging pace.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、やっかいな宿題も諦めずやるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm not going to give up on my homework, even though it's hard.
lines.style: Determined whisper. Serious for a six-year-old — he means this. Eyes focused. Small breath before the commitment, like he's gathering himself.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが滑稽なお話して下さって笑ったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad told us such a funny story. We all laughed.
lines.style: Warmth with a soft laugh underneath. Remembering joy. Slow, like she's savoring the moment. Voice tender at the edges.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、メイ姉さんに「有り難う」って心から言うよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I want to say thank you to you from my whole heart.
lines.style: Trembling slightly with sincerity. Child's voice stretched toward something bigger than him. Pause before the words land. Vulnerable, genuine, completely unguarded.
